title: Sky Ride

scenes.summary: Spot is introduced as a black and white dog.
scenes.image_prompt: cute black and white dog riding a unicycle, colorful cartoon sky background, children's book style

scenes.summary: Spot rides bikes with Mike and Spike.
scenes.text: He rides bikes with Mike and Spike.
scenes.image_prompt: three friends riding bikes together happily, bright sky, playful cartoon illustration

scenes.summary: Mike has a kite and they begin chasing and playing.
scenes.text: Mike has a kite. Let’s chase Mike, says Spike. They play hide and seek.
scenes.image_prompt: children riding bikes chasing a kite in the sky, fun colorful cartoon scene

scenes.summary: Mike suggests going down from the sky ride.
scenes.image_prompt: child pointing downward while riding in the sky with kites, bright clouds, cartoon style

scenes.summary: They land in slime at the end of their adventure.
scenes.image_prompt: kids and dog landing in green slime with surprised expressions, playful colorful illustration

story: Spot is black and white. He rides bikes with Mike and Spike. Mike has a kite. Let’s chase Mike, says Spike. They play hide and seek. Let’s go down, says Mike. Yikes! They land in slime!
